content: The execution was successful with a reward of 1.0. The strategy of using a single `<hp:t>` element per `<hp:run>` effectively resolved the common HWPX issue where placeholders are fragmented across multiple tags. Additionally, the removal of `<hp:lineSegArray>` tags was critical to prevent rendering artifacts (overlapping text) in the resulting HWPX file. Future tasks involving HWPX or similar OpenXML-based formats should continue to prioritize XML-aware normalization over raw regex to handle structural fragmentation.
